editorial:
Ever feel like your best years are behind you? That is exactly where you find yourself with the main character in this flick. He is a stay-at-home dad who is bored out of his mind and missing the glory days of high school. His wife is a hardworking corporate boss who is totally drained, so he decides to do something nice. He throws a huge 80s-themed surprise party and invites every single person he is still friends with on Facebook from back in the day. It sounds like a great plan, but you know things are about to get messy when people from the past show up with old grudges and wild personalities.

The acting is great and the chemistry between the couple feels real, making the funny moments hit harder. The pacing stays quick, though some of the side characters might feel a bit over the top for you. If you love awkward social situations and neon clothes, you will have a blast. You should definitely check this out by streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or you could rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a solid move.
endingExplained: The party ends in total chaos as old secrets come out and friendships are tested. After all the fighting and shouting, the husband finally realizes that clinging to the past is stopping him from being happy now. He and his wife have a heart-to-heart talk and decide to focus on their own family instead of high school memories. They clear out the house, forgive each other, and start fresh with a better outlook on their marriage.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves retro vibes and relatable marriage comedies.
